==About==

A {{i|Boiled Witch's Hat}} is made by boiling a {{i|Witch's Hat}} in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}}. With the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, a Boiled Witch's Hat can still be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Waning Toadstool. When planting a Boiled Witch's Hat there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Boiled Witch's Hat can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}. Both a Boiled Witch's Hat and a Witch's Hat count as a Witch's Hat when planting and in Food recipes. '''NOTE:''' There is a chance that even after Boiling, a Witch's Hat will still be poisonous.
